Frequently Asked Questions

How much do chair rentals cost?
Black padded folding chairs are $3 each — 15 are currently available in our inventory. White folding chairs are available by request starting at $3 each. Final quantity and availability are confirmed manually.
Can I rent chairs without an inflatable?
Yes. Standalone chair rentals are available by quote, with a minimum rental order before travel. Chairs can also be added to any inflatable, foam party, 360 Video Booth, tent, lawn game, or package booking.
Do you deliver chairs?
Yes. The first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Delivery, quantity, and final pricing are confirmed manually based on your date, location, and order size.
What events are chair rentals good for?
Birthdays, school events, community events, backyard parties, graduations, church events, markets, and fundraisers across the South Shore, HRM, Annapolis Valley, and Nova Scotia.
